notes.title: Update 0.3.0
notes.content: [p]Greetings Astro-Tycoons! Here comes the long-awaited worker update! You can now hire workers to automate tasks and build production chains.[/p][p][/p][p]🤖[b]Machine Worker[/b][/p][list][*][p]Assign to a machine[/p][/*][*][p]Picks up required input items from nearby pallets[/p][/*][*][p]Places produced crates onto pallets[/p][/*][*][p]Operates the machine automatically[/p][/*][/list][p]🛒[b]Checkout Worker[/b][/p][list][*][p]Assign to checkout stations[/p][/*][*][p]Scans customer items and collects credits[/p][/*][*][p]Streamlines your sales process[/p][/*][/list][p]⛏️[b]Mining Worker (coming soon)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Assign to pallet stations[/p][/*][*][p]Mines resources automatically[/p][/*][*][p]Collects scattered resources into crates and adds them to pallets[/p][/*][/list][p]📊[b]Skills System[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Production[/b]: Determines how quickly items are handled[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sell[/b]: Controls how fast items are scanned at checkout[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mining[/b]: Affects resource mining and collection speed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed[/b]: Determines worker movement speed[/p][/*][*][p][b]XP[/b]: Workers gain experience by performing their assigned tasks[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level[/b]: Each level increases the efficiency of the corresponding skill[/p][/*][*][p][b]Talent (stars)[/b]: Determines how quickly XP is gained[/p][/*][/list][p]✨[b]Additional Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Game Time[/b]: 24-hour day cycle with daily worker wage payments at start of day[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest Descriptions[/b]: Added helpful text to clarify objectives[/p][/*][*][p][b]Room Purchasing[/b]: Change the number of rooms you want to buy via the order console[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tooltips[/b]: Added helpful information for various world objects[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crate Icons[/b]: Now display the contents of each crate[/p][/*][*][p][b]Input System[/b]: New and improved input handling[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad Support[/b]: Partial controller support (not fully tested across all models yet)[/p][/*][*][p][b]General Polish[/b]: Various small improvements and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Happy playing, and let me know if you have any issues or feedback![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.2.4
notes.content:
Here are some bug fixes based on player feedback:

[list]
[*] fixed adding a room inside another room
[*] fixed infinite rooms glitch, where you could add rooms to crate from an invalid position
[*] added a check to place devices only in the right building. e.g: machine can only be placed inside a factory room
[*] fixed some errors when handling machine resources
[*] fixed some internal exceptions
[/list]

Thanks for playing and all the feedback!

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Astro-Tycoons![/p][p][/p][p]I’m excited to bring you the biggest update yet - a completely redesigned building system that puts you in full control of your space station's layout and design.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🏗️ New Modular Building System[/b] Transform how you construct your station with the new room-based approach:[/p][list][*][p][b]Shop Modules[/b] - Design custom retail spaces with freely placeable checkouts and product racks[/p][/*][*][p][b]Factory Modules[/b] - Create efficient production floors with optimized machine layouts[/p][/*][*][p][b]Habitat Modules[/b] - Coming soon: Staff quarters for hiring workers to automate your operations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]✨ Additional Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced shop furniture: new racks and shelving options for better product display[/p][/*][*][p]Flexible checkout placement - position registers anywhere in your shop[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tutorial to guide you through the new building mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Save file compatibility indicator - easily see if your saves need updating[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous quality-of-life fixes and optimizations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Ready to rebuild your empire? Fire up Astrocraft and start designing the space station of your dreams![/p][p]
[/p]
